metadata.description: Marketplace for plugins shipped with the agents-in-a-box toolkit. Plugins live under toolkit/packages/plugins/ and are installable via `claude plugin install <name>@agents-in-a-box`.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Agent self-improvement + retrieval. Captures learnings via colon-namespaced sub-skills (reflect, reflect:consolidate, reflect:ingest, reflect:recall, reflect:cost, reflect-status) and auto-injects relevant prior learnings at SessionStart via hook.

plugins.name: ainb-fleet
plugins.description: LLM-facing skill teaching agents how to use `ainb fleet ...` orchestration subcommands. Fleet covers multi-session broadcast, ack-gated sequence, blocked-session needs, and the auto-continue daemon. Replaces the deprecated `popa` plugin — the Node code is gone; the orchestration logic now lives in ainb's Rust binary.
